composition.serve_who: This sheet is page 09/12 of the ENGINE ROOM PLC set (SWS_108-1) and details module DI-01, a 750-1405 16-DI digital input module at rack position 00. The channel labels name EP1/EP2 (the engine-room hydraulic power packs / electric pumps of the ER hydraulic power supply) and a field power supply monitor, so this module's signals serve the Engine Room Hydraulic Power Pack node and the PLC rack infrastructure that hosts it. A sensor cross-reference (SENSOR TYPE D) points to sheet 4 for the oil-temperature sensor detail. Rack layout facts (coupler, module position, bus arrows 09.7F/10.1A/09.2B/6.4B) belong to the ENGINE ROOM PLC rack infrastructure node, not to the pump equipment.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Engine Room Hydraulic Power Pack (EP1/EP2 pump status & suction valve monitoring)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Channel labels explicitly name EP1 and EP2 (Engine-room hydraulic Power packs) power-available and oil-suction-valve status signals; these are digital inputs into the ENGINE ROOM PLC reporting the run/available state of the two hydraulic power packs supplying ship services.

functions.label: EP1 power available
functions.what_it_does: Channel 2 of module DI-01 (position 00, ENGINE ROOM rack) reads a dry contact signalling that EP1 (hydraulic power pack 1) electrical power is available/energised; wired back via reference 7/2:D.

flow_scenarios.path: EP1 power-available contact (ref 7/2:D) → DI-01 CH02 input → PLC logic reads EP1 available = true, relative to module common
contact open → DI-01 CH02 reads 0 = EP1 not available

functions.dry_data: 750-1405 16DI module, ch.02, wire ref 03.7 RD 1,5, cross-ref 7/2:D

functions.label: EP2 power available
functions.what_it_does: Channel 3 of DI-01 reads a dry contact signalling EP2 (hydraulic power pack 2) electrical power is available/energised; wired back via reference 7/4:D.

flow_scenarios.path: EP2 power-available contact (ref 7/4:D) → DI-01 CH03 input → PLC reads EP2 available = true, relative to module common

functions.dry_data: 750-1405 16DI module, ch.03, wire ref 04.7 RD 1,5, cross-ref 7/4:D

functions.label: EP1 oil suction valve
functions.what_it_does: Channel 4 of DI-01 monitors the status (open/closed feedback) of EP1's oil suction valve.

flow_scenarios.path: EP1 oil suction valve position switch → DI-01 CH04 → PLC reads valve state, relative to module common

functions.label: EP2 oil suction valve
functions.what_it_does: Channel 5 of DI-01 monitors the status of EP2's oil suction valve.

flow_scenarios.path: EP2 oil suction valve position switch → DI-01 CH05 → PLC reads valve state, relative to module common

functions.label: Oil temperature return section (Sensor Type D)
functions.what_it_does: Channel 1 of DI-01 reads a digital signal from a 'Sensor Type D' associated with the oil temperature of the return section, feeding the PLC. The sensor itself is detailed on sheet 4.

flow_scenarios.path: Sensor Type D (see sheet 4) → DI-01 CH01 → PLC reads oil-return-temperature digital indication, relative to module common (ground symbol shown at CH01 side)

functions.label: Field power supply monitor
functions.what_it_does: Channel 16 (last channel of module DI-01) monitors the +24Vdc field power supply feeding the rack's field devices, confirming field power presence.

flow_scenarios.path: +24Vdc field supply monitor tap (ref 05.6 RD 1, continuing to bus arrow 10.1A) → DI-01 CH16 → PLC reads field power OK, relative to module common
no voltage at tap → DI-01 CH16 reads 0 = field power fault
